test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A @ B means ‘A is the husband of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

If G % V @ K & P and,

G # S % M, then how is S related to P?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png]

A is

@

to B

 
 
 

Statements given : G % V @ K & P and G # S % M

Explanation :

 
• G % V → G is the sister of V.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffa22e265f6ed1d0448ccabd6d9ce16052adfd24527b8d51a46f0e27f6358cb9.png] 

 
• V @ K → V is the husband of K.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f342d7b1c6f903140e58f790c64ff5083f3ba4e9ad3d9dc52a3973a87a3f9b24.png] 

 
• K & P → K is the mother of P.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0023fc66e47f542aede8f33802009c54ddee6bf10aca89f7f98ec9d199f9838.png] 

 
• G # S → G is the daughter of S.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a23a8a4ee820fd26dc8528dcc5b7f6aff868a0633231cdfe0ff5e1880b78d76.png] 

 
• S % M → S is the sister of M.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa95747ef750c2046b293f9f987fa3cc2a55b73391993016df80fb46bb0023d7.png] 

Thus, from the final family tree S is the paternal grandmother i.e father's mother of P.

Hence, "**Father’s mother**" is the correct answer.
